result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by eliminating Licensor’s unilateral seven-year renewal right, requiring mutual written agreement for renewal, limiting renewal periods to 12 months, and capping fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. It preserves unrelated termination rights. However, the 60-day notice requirement is unnecessary for the mutual-agreement renewal option under the playbook, and the clause retains duplicative and defective language in Sections II and III, including “mutual written of the parties,” creating avoidable ambiguity and reducing drafting quality.
